models.name: GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst
models._note: Images 2.6 API model (detail / edit-consistency tier). Base id = max quality (AA arena setting "max"). Announced https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/ (2026-11-04); system card https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/chatgpt-images-2-6

models.name: GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst (Medium)
models._note: Medium-quality setting of GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst as listed on LMArena (arena.ai) image leaderboards.

models.name: GPT-Image-2.6 Flare
models._note: Images 2.6 speed-tier API model (as little as ~6 s at low quality per OpenAI). Base id = max quality (AA arena setting "max").

models.name: GPT-Image-2.6 Flare (Medium)
models._note: Medium-quality setting of GPT-Image-2.6 Flare as listed on LMArena image leaderboards.

models.name: MAI-Image-2.7
models._note: MAI Image 2.7 (text-to-image + editing), public preview on Microsoft Foundry from 2026-11-17 at ~$35 per 1,000 images (https://microsoft.ai/news/introducing-mai-image-2-7/). An editing-only preview was shown on arenas from 2026-10-27; AA lists release 2026-11-17.

models.name: MAI-Image-2.7-Flash
models._note: Flash variant of MAI Image 2.7, ~$10 per 1,000 images (Microsoft AI announcement 2026-11-17).

models.name: Kling Image 4.0
models._note: Kling AI image model, native 8K output, up to 10 consistent images per prompt, multilingual text. Launch press release dated 2026-11-17 (Media OutReach; some outlets 2026-11-18). AA image leaderboard release 2026-11-17 (scored at 2048x2048, downscaled to 1024 for the arena).

models.name: Seedream 5.5
models._note: Seedream 5.5 image generation + editing (100-round stable editing, native RGBA). Blog https://seed.bytedance.com/blog/more-realistic-images-more-stable-editing-across-100-rounds-introducing-seedream-5-5 ; a 5.5 Pro is announced for later.

models.name: Krea 3 (Ultra)
models._note: Krea 3 image-to-image (editing) model; base id = Ultra mode (highest quality). Closed weights (API via fal/Replicate/OpenRouter/Together). Tech report https://www.krea.ai/blog/krea-3-technical-report

models.name: Krea 3 (Fast)
models._note: Krea 3 Fast mode (production default; edits in ~8 s at 2K).

models.name: FLUX 3 Image
models._note: Image tier of the multimodal FLUX 3 family (announced 2026-07-23, https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3); API release 2026-10-01 per AA/OpenRouter. Closed (API + private weights).

models.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein
models._note: 5.6B open-weights (FLUX Kommunity License) text-to-image + editing + multi-reference model; this id = step-distilled release model (16 steps). https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein

models.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein (base)
models._note: Undistilled base checkpoint of FLUX 3 Image Klein (50 steps), released for fine-tuning.

models.name: MOSS-Image
models._note: Open-source (Apache 2.0) 5B single-stream diffusion transformer for long-text rendering and layout control; MOSS-Image-Base and MOSS-Image-SFT weights released 2026-10-16. https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image (technical report paper/MOSS_Image_Technical_Report.pdf).

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1
models._note: Open-weight (Qwen Research License) unified T2I + editing + native transparency model; 7B visual generation component (32 single-stream DiT layers). Blog https://www.alibabacloud.com/blog/603586 ; weights https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1-Pro
models._note: API (Model Studio) Pro tier of Qwen-Image-2.1, listed by AA with release 2026-10-09. Same 7B Qwen-Image-2.1 architecture; Model Studio list price $0.04/image Singapore, $0.035333 Global (https://www.alibabacloud.com/blog/603679, 2026-10-26).

models.name: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo
models._note: API (Model Studio) Turbo tier of Qwen-Image-2.1, listed by AA with release 2026-10-09. Same 7B Qwen-Image-2.1 architecture; Model Studio list price $0.016/image Singapore, $0.014133 Global; open Turbo checkpoint runs 8 denoising steps vs 40 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/blog/603679, 2026-10-26).

models.name: Nano Banana 2.1 (No Thinking)
